label: spatial concept
definition_en: A concept concerning physical location, regions, extents, routes, spatial relations, or arrangement.

label: locational concept
definition_en: A concept specifying a physical place, point, or region relative to a reference.

label: relative region
definition_en: A spatial region specified with respect to one or more boundaries or reference entities.

label: reference location
definition_en: A point or position determined in a reference space or figure.

label: inter-entity relation
definition_en: A relation describing separation or immediate nearness between spatial references.

label: spatial interval
definition_en: An interval, opening, or degree of separation between spatial references.

label: immediate nearness
definition_en: A relation of direct neighborhood or physical meeting between entities.

label: spatial limit
definition_en: A line or surface delimiting a spatial region.

label: spatial route
definition_en: A route through space along which movement could occur.

label: spatial structural property
definition_en: A geometric or bodily property of how parts, lines, or entities are arranged.

label: 位置
definition_en: A specified point or extent in a reference space.

label: 内部
definition_en: The region enclosed by a reference entity.

label: 外部
definition_en: A region beyond the boundary of a reference entity

label: 边界
definition_en: A line delimiting the extent of an area.

label: 中心
definition_en: A central point fixed by the limits of a reference figure.

label: 之间
definition_en: An intervening region bounded by two specified reference entities

label: 路径
definition_en: A route along which motion could occur.

label: proximity
definition_en: A short distance between entities relative to a specified scale.

label: distance
definition_en: The measurable separation between two locations.

label: gap
definition_en: An open interval or space between bounded entities.

label: adjacency
definition_en: A relation in which entities lie immediately next to each other.

label: alignment
definition_en: The arrangement of entities along a common line or direction.

label: angle
definition_en: The amount of turn between intersecting lines or planes.

label: posture
definition_en: The spatial arrangement of a body and its limbs.

label: contact
definition_en: A state in which two physical surfaces meet.
